title: Gravitee · API Drill-down
description: Everything about one API: health, status codes, methods, per-path latency, consumers, and the individual failed or slow calls, down to their call logs.

links.tooltip: Headers and payloads of this API's logged calls

panels.title: Latency breakdown (P95)
panels.description: Connect time spikes → network/DNS/TLS to the backend. TTFB ≈ backend processing. Gateway overhead → policies.

panels.title: Response time distribution
panels.description: Each cell = number of calls with that response time (50 ms buckets). Bands reveal bimodal behaviour (cache hits vs misses, fast vs slow backends).

panels.title: Endpoints: traffic, errors & latency
panels.description: Per-path view (path after the API context path), recorded by Gravitee on every call — no per-path metric to configure.

panels.title: Calls by plan
panels.description: Plan names come from the Assign Metrics stamp (custom.plan, Enterprise). Calls without a stamp are grouped by plan id.

panels.title: Latest failed calls (4xx/5xx)
panels.description: Raw request records. Click a request id to open the call's headers and payloads in Call Logs (available when API logging is enabled and the call was logged).

value.title: Open the call log (headers & payloads), if this call was logged

panels.description: Calls slower than 500 ms, with the gateway/backend/connect split for each one. Click a request id to open its call log.
